plan.title: Implement planOrder with order/stages and typed errors
plan.description: Create src/planner.ts implementing planOrder(tasks: TaskSpec[]): {order, stages} using Kahn/topological sort with deterministic ordering. Extend src/errors.ts with DuplicateTaskIdError, UnknownDependencyError, CycleError (extending TaskPlanError) as per SPEC 2. Update src/index.ts exports. Ensure duplicate ids, unknown deps and cycles throw typed errors.
acceptance: planOrder returns correct order and stages for DAGs
cycle throws CycleError with cycle info
visible tests pass and tsc passes
plan.reason: Core algorithm with cycle detection and typed error hierarchy needs strong reasoning

plan.description: Implement src/cli.ts providing `plan` command per SPEC 3: read tasks file, call planOrder, output order/stages in text/json formats, handle typed errors with messages and non-zero exit codes. Wire to bin if needed via src/index entry without modifying package.json in this task's file list.

plan.reason: Docs and example are straightforward templating after core exists

findings.evidence: SPEC/task requires class named DuplicateTaskIdError extending TaskPlanError. Implementation provides DuplicateTaskError class with a value-alias const DuplicateTaskIdError. The alias works for instanceof/new at runtime but does not provide a type (cannot be used as `type`/`instanceof` type) and makes constructor.name === 'DuplicateTaskError' instead of 'DuplicateTaskIdError'. Not breaking visible instanceof tests but diverges from spec naming.
findings.suggested_check: Verify tsc with `import type { DuplicateTaskIdError } from './src/errors.ts'` and check expected error name/code; consider defining `export class DuplicateTaskIdError extends TaskPlanError` (and optionally `export type DuplicateTaskError = DuplicateTaskIdError` / alias the other way) so both names are proper classes/types.

findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria requires `tsc passes`. With ESM/NodeNext module resolution, explicit `.ts` extensions in imports are not resolvable by TypeScript without `allowImportingTsExtensions`/`rewrite` flags; `tsc --noEmit` will error TS2307: Cannot find module './tasks.ts'. Baseline src/index.ts previously used `./errors.ts` etc., but if tsc project does not enable those flags it will fail. Even if previously present, keeping them risks tsc failure; correct import should be `./tasks` etc. or build config must be verified.
findings.suggested_check: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` on the repo as checked in; confirm whether imports with `.ts` extension cause TS2307 errors.

findings.evidence: File read failures output `error: <node message>` plus usage with exit 2. Task description says typed errors (duplicate/unknown/cycle) should show typed message and exit 1; implementation does that, but file-not-found now emits untyped generic error which may not match expected harness that looks for exit 2 + usage. Not blocking unless spec requires stderr exactly equals typed error format.
findings.suggested_check: Invoke CLI with non-existent file path and assert exit code 2 and that stderr contains USAGE string.

findings.evidence: Text format special-cases empty result to only print `Order:` line, dropping stages output entirely. If expected text format is always `Stage ...` lines followed by `Order:` line (even when empty), this diverges. Could cause test expecting at least `Stage` handling or empty JSON vs text parity to fail, though not explicitly required.
findings.suggested_check: Run CLI against task file `[]` and compare text output to expected fixture; verify whether empty input should output nothing, `Order:` alone, or `Order:` + stages count.

findings.evidence: Entry point re-exports additional error subtypes not in baseline. While harmless, task description says wire to bin if needed via src/index entry without modifying package.json; adding exports is okay but could expose internal error classes prematurely. No functional impact.
findings.suggested_check: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and ensure index.ts exports don't create circular or missing-export errors if error names don't exist in errors.ts.
